name: @mdreader/e2e-native
description: Milestone PT — the UNIFIED Appium + WebdriverIO GUI functional-test harness for MDReader across desktop (macOS/Windows/Linux) and mobile (iOS/Android). One runner + shared behavioural spec (flows.ts) + per-driver adapters. Deliberately OUTSIDE the pnpm workspace: its Appium/WebdriverIO toolchain installs on demand (locally + in CI) and never bloats the root lockfile. The macOS leg (appium-mac2-driver) additionally shells out to a compiled Swift AX helper to read WKWebView's accessibility tree, which no WebDriver surface exposes.

scripts.build:e2e: pnpm --filter '@mdreader/app...' run build && pnpm --filter @mdreader/app tauri build --bundles app --features e2e-build --config src-tauri/tauri.e2e.conf.json
